title: Documenting a fixture change
passage: Tomorrow we'll replace only the long fixture support with a shorter one. Photograph the old setup from the side. Start a new results page after the switch, even for the same product model. Enter the support length in millimetres; both setups share a product name in the menu. Don't remove the old support until the photo is saved. Once the photo is saved, hand the support directly to the reviewer if they're still there. Otherwise, put it in the bottom cabinet for Friday's review.
passageZh: 明天只會把治具上的長支撐件換成較短的。請從側面拍下原配置。更換後，即使產品型號相同，也要另開一頁記錄結果。請以毫米輸入支撐件長度；兩種配置在選單上使用同一個產品名稱。照片存好前不要取走舊支撐件。照片存好後，如果審查人員還在場，就把支撐件直接交給他；如果已不在場，就放進下方的櫃子，留待星期五審查。
